title: Local State Management
description: Learn how to manage local state with Apollo Client.

data.text: Apollo Client can manage local state alongside remote data. This eliminates the need for separate state management libraries.

data.title: makeVar
Local Fields
@client Directive
data.text: The @client directive tells Apollo to resolve the field locally instead of sending it to the server.

data.title: Key Takeaways
data.takeaway: Apollo can manage both remote and local state.
